purposeScenes.welcome: Welcome-to-Slay-Society onboarding email. Medium-wide 3D frosted-glass VIP membership pedestal on marble — full cube and base fully visible with breathing room, NOT zoomed in. Center of the glass cube: one smooth blank frosted plaque panel (completely empty — no text, no FS seal, no SLAYER or MEMBERSHIP embossing). Crimson rose petals and scattered diamonds at the base only. Warm celebratory light.
purposeScenes.newsletter: Frontal Slayer marketing newsletter email. Editorial luxury beauty flat-lay on marble — glass editorial card with a blank cream brand patch (no print), diamond accents and a single crimson rose, magazine-cover composition filling the full 9:16 frame with immersive depth.
purposeScenes.email_verification: Verify-your-email security email. Elegant 3D white envelope partially open inside a glass vitrine on marble, smooth blank crimson wax seal disc on the envelope flap (no embossing or text), soft confirmation glow — communicates confirm your address.
purposeScenes.email_confirmed: Email-verified success email. Large luminous crimson checkmark inside a diamond-cut glass frame on marble, subtle success sparkle and roses — clear you're verified moment.
purposeScenes.password_reset: Password reset request email. Heavy photorealistic crimson padlock on a glass pedestal with a silver key beside it, security-focused studio lighting, roses as accent — urgent but luxury, not playful.
purposeScenes.password_reset_success: Password successfully reset email. Padlock open with soft green-crimson success glow, glossy checkmark reflection in frosted glass on marble, celebratory diamond sparkles.
purposeScenes.password_changed: Account security alert — password changed email. Crimson padlock paired with a translucent security shield on marble, alert-toned rim light, refined roses — communicates protection and change detected.
purposeScenes.profile_updated: Profile saved confirmation email. Frosted-glass circular profile silhouette with a small crimson verified badge on marble, soft personal concierge glow — account settings updated.
purposeScenes.email_updated: Account email address changed notification. Two elegant 3D envelopes on marble — one fading, one fresh with a smooth blank crimson wax seal disc (no text or symbols).
purposeScenes.account_login_alert: New sign-in detected security alert email. Smooth blank crimson wax seal disc beside a subtle shield and location-pin glow on marble, alert rim lighting — new device login, not celebration.
purposeScenes.order_received: Order received acknowledgment email. White luxury shopping bag with a blank cream brand patch on the front (no print) and a crimson rose peeking out, resting in an open glass display on marble — we got your order boutique moment.
purposeScenes.order_confirmed: Order payment confirmed email. Premium crimson-accent shipping box with a large glossy checkmark seal on marble, roses and diamond sparkles — payment cleared, order locked in.
purposeScenes.order_processing: Order being prepared email. Atelier scene: gloved hands arranging a luxury wig unit inside an open presentation box on marble, subtle silver craft gears and crimson rose — salon preparation in progress.
purposeScenes.order_shipped: Order shipped with tracking email. Crimson-accent premium shipping box mid-motion on marble with elegant speed streaks and a floating tracking-route ribbon (no readable text), roses at base — package is on the way.
purposeScenes.order_out_for_delivery: Out-for-delivery today email. 3D crimson map pin hovering above a doorstep shipping box on marble, warm afternoon delivery light, roses nearby — arriving today.
purposeScenes.order_delivered: Package delivered email. Opened luxury shipping box on marble with tissue and a white shopping bag with blank cream brand patch visible inside (no print), celebratory roses and soft delivered glow — safe arrival moment.
purposeScenes.order_delayed: Shipment delayed update email. Elegant glass hourglass with crimson sand beside a patiently waiting shipping box on marble, calm patient luxury tone — delay, not failure.
purposeScenes.order_canceled: Order canceled notification email. Refined crimson X mark inside frosted glass on marble, muted somber studio light, single rose — clear cancellation, still premium.
purposeScenes.payment_received: Payment received confirmation email. Glossy payment card silhouette with a crimson checkmark burst inside glass on marble, diamond sparkles — funds captured successfully.
purposeScenes.partially_shipped: Split / partial shipment email. Two premium boxes on marble — one sealed with checkmark, one open with product tissue — visual split-shipment story with roses.
purposeScenes.points_earned: Loyalty points earned email. Towering brilliant-cut diamond on a glass pedestal with upward crimson light rays suggesting rising points, roses framing — reward credited.
purposeScenes.points_redeemed: Points redeemed for reward email. Glass tray on marble with a blank frosted brand plaque (no text) and a redeemed gift voucher card emerging from diamond dust and roses — points turned into value.
purposeScenes.points_expiring: Points expiring soon urgency email. Hourglass with crimson sand nearly empty beside fading diamond particles on marble, urgent elegant rim light — use points before they expire.
purposeScenes.voucher_expiring: Member voucher expiring email. Luxury gift voucher card with ribbon beside a glass hourglass on marble, crimson urgency glow — deadline approaching.
purposeScenes.referral_redeemed: Referral reward redeemed email. Two stylized glass silhouettes sharing a floating crimson heart between them on marble, referral celebration depth — friend reward unlocked.
purposeScenes.digital_cash_update: Digital cash balance update email. Glass sphere on pedestal encasing a smooth blank crimson wax seal disc (no text) and subtle coin-stack reflection inside, balance-update glow on marble.
purposeScenes.membership_welcome: Premium membership activated email. Black-glass premium member card with gold crown hint and a blank embossed brand area (no text), roses and diamonds on marble — subscription welcome, elevated tier.
purposeScenes.tier_upgraded: Rewards tier upgraded email. Glass trophy plaque on marble with tier-upgrade crimson-to-diamond light burst, roses framing — status level increased.
purposeScenes.birthday_reward: Birthday reward gift email. Golden crown on glass stand beside a white gift box with crimson ribbon and birthday roses on marble — personal celebration gift.
purposeScenes.special_offer: Exclusive special offer email. White gift box with crimson satin ribbon on a glass pedestal on marble with a blank frosted brand plaque (no text), spotlight exclusive-offer energy — limited discount moment.
purposeScenes.affiliate_content_received: Affiliate content submission received email. 3D smartphone/camera uploading into a glowing glass inbox cube on marble, crimson check circle — content safely received.
purposeScenes.affiliate_content_pending: Affiliate content pending review email. Minimalist glass clock face inside a frosted cube on marble, patient review-queue mood with a single rose — awaiting approval.
purposeScenes.affiliate_content_approved: Affiliate content approved email. Large brilliant diamond exploding with approval sparkle inside glass on marble, abundant roses and diamonds — celebration approval.
purposeScenes.affiliate_content_denied: Affiliate content needs revision email. Crimson circle with white X inside frosted glass on marble, constructive not harsh lighting — needs adjustment.
purposeScenes.affiliate_points_earned: Affiliate points credited email. Large central diamond surrounded by a constellation of smaller diamonds and roses inside glass on marble — creator points earned.
purposeScenes.affiliate_payment_sent: Affiliate payout sent email. Glass cube on marble with a payout envelope bearing a smooth blank crimson wax seal disc (no text), elegant roses — payment on the way to creator.
purposeScenes.back_in_stock: Back-in-stock alert for a wig unit email. Black luxury lace-front wig on a mannequin head inside a lit glass boutique display case on marble, spotlight restock energy, rose accent — NOIR/restock mood.
purposeScenes.wishlist_price_drop: Wishlist item price drop email. White shopping bag with blank cream brand patch (no print) and crimson roses blooming upward on marble, downward price-arrow light streak (no readable text) — saved item now cheaper.
purposeScenes.consult_offer_sent: Custom consult offer ready email. White gift box with crimson ribbon beside a stylized custom wig sketch card on glass pedestal on marble — personalized offer from concierge.
purposeScenes.meeting_reschedule: Appointment reschedule request email. 3D calendar pages flipping with crimson accent inside glass on marble, soft reschedule energy — pick a new time.
purposeScenes.meeting_cancel: Appointment cancellation email. Refined crimson X on a calendar tile inside frosted glass on marble, calm professional cancel tone — not aggressive.
